metrics.hybrid_policy: target-observed startup and tail + frozen source-only 1F1B prediction; NOT independent full iteration prediction

evidence.time_origin: rank0 first F associated GPU start; ms
evidence.scope: rank0 only; last AG observed, not proven full-world optimizer completion

loss_slot.accounting: additional cost only; avoid double counting last F

source32.read_scope: argument prefix only, no target timing

target256.read_scope: argument prefix only, no target timing

candidate.scope: same 80MiB PP payload; effective cost, not pure network service; do not extrapolate beyond PP4..16 without verification
candidate.fit_objective: equal-weight least squares on F/B target medians, NOT total iteration error
candidate.replay: exact scalar contraction of unchanged F/B templates; original frozen window reproduced within 1e-6 ms
